verses.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.sm: ONA alalaga ai lea o le faapotopotoga uma, ua fetagisi foi le nuu i lea po.

verses.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.sm: Ua muimui foi le fanauga a Isaraelu uma lava ia Mose ma Arona, ua fai mai foi le faapotopotoga uma ia te i laua, E ! ana matou oti i le nuu o Aikupito. E ! ana matou oti i lenei vao.

verses.en: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.sm: Se a ea le mea ua au mai ai Ieova ia te i matou i lenei nuu ia oti i le pelu, e avea foi o matou fafine ma o matou tama iti o tagata o taua ? E le lelei ea ona matou toe foi atu i Aikupito ?

verses.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.sm: Ona latou fetautalatalai ai lea, Se‘i tatou tofia so tatou ta‘ita‘i, ma tatou foi atu i Aikupito.

verses.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona faapauufao ai lea o Mose ma Arona i luma o tagata uma o le faapotopotoga o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.sm: O Iosua foi le atalii o Nuno, ma Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, o i laua sa i le asiasiga o le nuu, ua la saeia o la ofu ;

verses.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.sm: ua la fai ane foi i le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, O le nuu na matou ui ai e asiasi ai, o le nuu e matuā lelei tasi lava ia.

verses.en: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.sm: Afai e finagalo alofa mai Ieova ia te i tatou, na te faaootia lava i tatou i lena nuu, ma foai mai ai ia te i tatou; o le nuu lava ua tafe ai le suāsusu ma le meli.

verses.en: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
verses.sm: A e aua lava nefi outou fouvale ia ieova, aua foi tou te matatau i tagata o le nuu, auā e faia lava i latou ma mea e ‘ai mā tatou ; ua mavae lo latou mamalu ia te i latou, a o loo ia te i tatou Ieova ; aua tou te matatau ia te i latou.

verses.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.sm: A ua fai ane le faapotopotoga uma e fetogi ia te i laua i maa. Ona faaali mai ai lea o le pupula o Ieova i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i luma o le fanauga a Isaraelu uma lava.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova ia Mose, E 4no‘ino mai lenei nuu ia te au seia afea ? E ui lava i faailoga uma ua ou faia ia te i latou, a e latou te le faatuatua lava ia te au seia afea ?

verses.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.sm: Ou te taia i latou i le faamai, ou te faaumatia foi i latou, ou te faia foi oe ma tupuga o le nuu e tele ma le malosi, e sili ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mose ia Ieova, E faalogo mai i ai o Aikupito, (auā na e aveina ae lenei nuu i lou mana nai ia te i latou ;)

verses.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.sm: latou te ta‘u atu ai foi i e o nonofo i le nuu nei; auā ua latou faalogo lava, o oe lava, Ieova e, o loo e afio i totonu o lenei nuu, o oe foi ieova o loo iloa oe ua faafeagai lava; o le ao foi mai ia te oe o loo tu i o latou luga, o loo e afio foi i luma ia te i latou i le ao faaniutu ina o ao, ma le afi faaniutu ina o po.

verses.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.sm: O lenei, afai e te fasiotia lenei nuu, e pei o se tagata e toatasi, ona tautala ane ai lea o nuu ese o e ua iloa le logo ia te oe, e faapea ane,

verses.en: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.sm: E le mafaia e Ieova ona faaoo lenei nuu i le nuu na tauto ai o ia ia te i latou,

verses.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.sm: o le mea lava lea ua na te aioi atu ia te oe, ia tele le mamana o lo‘u Alii, e pei ona e fetalai mai ai, ua faapea,

verses.en: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.sm: O Ieova. e telegese lona toasa, e tele foi le alofa, e faamagalo atu i le agasala ma le solitulafono, a e le faasaoina lava e agasala, e tauia e ia le agasala a mātua i le fanau e oo i le tolu ma le fa o tupulaga.

verses.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.sm: Ou te aioi atu lava, ia e faamagalo le agasala a lenei nuu, ia tusa ma le tele o lou alofa, e pei ona e faamagaloina atu foi i lenei nuu talu ona o mai i Aikupito ua oo lava i ona po nei.

verses.en: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova, Ua ou faamagaloina atu e tusa ma lau upu ;

verses.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
verses.sm: a e peitai, o loo ola a‘u, e faatumuina lava le lalolagi uma lava i le mamalu o Ieova ;

verses.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.sm: auā o na tagata uma o e na iloa lo‘u mamalu ma o‘u faailoga na ou faia i Aikupito ma le vao, ma ua tofotofo faasefulu lava ia te au, ma latou le faalogo i lo‘u leo ;

verses.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.sm: latou te le iloa lava le nuu na ou tauto ai i o latou tamā, e leai lava so latou o e ‘ino- ‘ino mai ia te au e vaai i ai.

verses.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.sm: A o la‘u auauna o Kalepo, ona ua ia te ia le loto e ese i o latoū, ua na matuā mulimuli mai lava ia te au, o le mea lea ou te faaoo ai ia te ia i le nuu na ia alu a-tu i ai, e fai foi lea mo lana fanau.

verses.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.sm: (Sa nonofo sa Amalekā ma sa Kananā i le vanu.) A taeao ia outou liliu ane, ma o atu i le vao, i le ala i le sami Ulaula.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi Ieova ia Mose ma Arona, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.sm: Ou te faapalepale ea seia afea i lenei faapotopotoga leaga, o i latou lava o e muimui mai ia te au ? Ua ou lagona lava i muimuiga a le fanauga a Isaraelu ua latou muimui mai ai 4a te au.

verses.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.sm: Ia e fai atu ia te i latou, O loo fai mai Ieova, o loo ola a‘u, ou te faia lava ia te outou e pei o a outou upu ua oo mai i o‘u taliga;

verses.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.sm: e oti o outou tino i lenei lava vao ; o outou uma lava na faitaulia, e tusa ma le faitau aofai o outou uma, e afua mai i e ua luafulu o latou tausaga atoa ma e ua matutua ai, o e na muimui mai ia te au ;

verses.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.sm: tou te le oo atu lava i le nuu na ou tauto ai tou te nonofo ai, na o Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, ma Iosua iti na outou fai mai ai,

verses.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.sm: E fai i latou ma tagata o taua, ou te faaoo ia te i latou, latou te iloa lava le nuu ua inosia e outou.

verses.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.sm: A o outou, e oti o outou tino i lenei lava vao.

verses.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.sm: O a outou fanau foi latou te feoai i le vao e fagafulu o tausaga, e tauave foi e i latou a outou mulilulua, seia faaumatia o outou tino i le vao.

verses.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.sm: E faatatau i le faitau o po na outou asiasi ai le nuu, e fagafulu o po, o le po e tasi o le faatatau lea o le tausaga e tasi, e fagafulu o tausaga lava tou te tauave ai o outou agasala, ona outou iloa ai lea o lo‘u lafoaiina o outoū.

verses.en: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.sm: O a‘u lava o Ieova, ua ou fai atu, ou te matuā faia lava i lenei faapotopotoga leaga uma lava o e ua faapotopotoina e tetee mai ia te au ; e faaumatia i latou i lenei lava vao, ma latou oti ai lava.

verses.en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.sm: O tagata foi na aauina e Mose e asiasi i le nuu, ma latou toe foi mai, ma faatupuina le muimui o le faapotopotoga uma ia te ia i lo latou fai tala leaga i le nuu,

verses.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.sm: o ia lava tagata na fai tala leaga i le nuu, ua oti lava i latou i le mala i luma o ieova.

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.sm: A o Iosua le atalii o Nuno, ma Kalepo le atalii o Iefune na ola i laua ai ia tagata na 5 e asiasi i le nuu.

verses.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.sm: Ua talatalaina atu e Mose ia upu i le fanauga a Isaraelu uma lava, ona matuā tele ai lea o le faanoanoa o le nuu.

verses.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.sm: Ona latou usuusu ai lea i le taeao, ma o ae i le tumutumu mauga, ua faapea ane, Faauta, o i matou nei, matou te o ae i le mea na fetalai mai ai Ieova; auā ua matou agasala.

verses.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
verses.sm: A ua fai atu Mose, Se a le mea tou te soli ai le afioga a Ieova? a e le manuia lava lea mea.

verses.en: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.sm: Aua lava tou te o ae, auā e le o ia te outou Ieova; ina ne‘i fasia outou i luma o e fai outou ma fili.

verses.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
verses.sm: Auā o i ai i o outou luma o sa Amalekā ma sa Kananā, e oti lava outou i le pelu ; auā ua outou liliu ese ia Ieova, o le mea lea e le i ai Ieova ia te outou.

verses.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.sm: A ua latou o faamaualuga i le tumutumu mauga ; a o le atolaau o le feagaiga a Ieova ma Mose e lei te‘a ese ia ma le toagālauapi.

verses.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.sm: Ona o ifo ai lea o sa Amalekā ma sa Kananā o e na latou, ma tutuli ia te i latou ua oo lava i Horema.
